pr.body: `ledger.py` validates built-in integer balances and transfer amounts, isolates caller-owned dictionaries, and uses one lock for transfers and snapshots. Added tests for invalid and boundary inputs, unknown accounts including unhashable identifiers, no mutation on failed transfers, self-transfers, copy isolation, and opposite-direction threaded transfers. Checks: `python -m unittest -v` (7 passed), `python -m py_compile ledger.py test_ledger.py` (passed), `git diff --check` (passed). Assumption: unknown non-hashable account arguments count as unknown and raise KeyError, consistent with the SPEC's unqualified unknown-account behavior.
pr.summary: Implemented the bounded thread-safe ledger and added focused edge case and concurrency coverage. Before: ledger methods were unimplemented and baseline tests errored. Now: validation, atomic transfers, snapshots, and documented failure behavior are covered and passing.
pr.title: Implement atomic ledger per specification
